001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006import java.util.Set;
007import java.util.TreeSet;
008
009/**
010 * Basal-IQ (predictive low glucose suspend) periodic record.
011 */
012
013/**
014 * History log record PLGS Periodic, opCode 140, size 26.
015 *
016 * <br>
017 *
018 * Basal-IQ (predictive low glucose suspend) periodic record.
019 *
020 * 
021 * <table border='1'>
022 * <caption>Message properties:</caption>
023 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>opCode</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>140</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
024 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>displayName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"PLGS Periodic"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
025 * <tr><th>&nbsp;<code>internalName</code>&nbsp;</th><td>&nbsp;<code>"LID_PLGS_PERIODIC"</code>&nbsp;</td></tr>
026 * </table>
027 */@HistoryLogProps(
028    opCode = 140,
029    displayName = "PLGS Periodic",
030    internalName = "LID_PLGS_PERIODIC"
031)
032public class PlgsPeriodicHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
033
034    private long timestamp;
035    private int fmr;
036    private int pgv;
037    private int fmrStatus;
038    private boolean pgvValid;
039    private int ruleState;
040    private int hoMinState;
041    private long status;
042
043    public PlgsPeriodicHistoryLog() {}
044    public PlgsPeriodicHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum) {
045        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, 0, 0, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 0);
046    }
047
048    public PlgsPeriodicHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long timestamp, int fmr, int pgv, int fmrStatus, boolean pgvValid, int ruleState, int hoMinState, long status) {
049        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
050        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, timestamp, fmr, pgv, fmrStatus, pgvValid, ruleState, hoMinState, status);
051        parse(cargo);
052    }
053
054    public PlgsPeriodicHistoryLog(long timestamp, int fmr, int pgv, int fmrStatus, boolean pgvValid, int ruleState, int hoMinState, long status) {
055        this(0, 0, timestamp, fmr, pgv, fmrStatus, pgvValid, ruleState, hoMinState, status);
056    }
057
058    public int typeId() {
059        return 140;
060    }
061
062    /**
063     * <table border="1">
064     * <caption>Parsed fields for PlgsPeriodicHistoryLog:</caption>
065     * <tr><td><code>timestamp</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
066     * <tr><td><code>fmr</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
067     * <tr><td><code>pgv</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 16)</code></td></tr>
068     * <tr><td><code>fmrStatus</code></td><td><code>raw[18] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
069     * <tr><td><code>pgvValid</code></td><td><code>raw[19] != 0</code></td></tr>
070     * <tr><td><code>ruleState</code></td><td><code>raw[20] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
071     * <tr><td><code>hoMinState</code></td><td><code>raw[21] &amp; 0xFF</code></td></tr>
072     * <tr><td><code>status</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
073     * </table>
074     */
075    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
076        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
077        this.cargo = raw;
078        parseBase(raw);
079        this.timestamp = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10);
080        this.fmr = Bytes.readShort(raw, 14);
081        this.pgv = Bytes.readShort(raw, 16);
082        this.fmrStatus = raw[18] & 0xFF;
083        this.pgvValid = raw[19] != 0;
084        this.ruleState = raw[20] & 0xFF;
085        this.hoMinState = raw[21] & 0xFF;
086        this.status = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22);
087    }
088
089    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum) {
090        return buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, 0, 0, 0, 0, false, 0, 0, 0);
091    }
092
093    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long timestamp, int fmr, int pgv, int fmrStatus, boolean pgvValid, int ruleState, int hoMinState, long status) {
094        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
095            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(140, 0),
096            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
097            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
098            Bytes.toUint32(timestamp),
099            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(fmr),
100            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(pgv),
101            new byte[]{(byte) fmrStatus},
102            new byte[]{(byte) (pgvValid ? 1 : 0)},
103            new byte[]{(byte) ruleState},
104            new byte[]{(byte) hoMinState},
105            Bytes.toUint32(status)));
106    }
107
108    /**
109     * @return timestamp, in seconds
110     */
111    public long getTimestamp() {
112        return timestamp;
113    }
114    /**
115     * @return five minute reading, in mg/dL
116     */
117    public int getFmr() {
118        return fmr;
119    }
120    /**
121     * @return predicted glucose value, in mg/dL
122     */
123    public int getPgv() {
124        return pgv;
125    }
126    /**
127     * @return raw FMR status, see {@link FmrStatus}
128     */
129    public int getFmrStatus() {
130        return fmrStatus;
131    }
132    public FmrStatus getFmrStatusEnum() {
133        return FmrStatus.fromId(fmrStatus);
134    }
135    /**
136     * @return whether the predicted glucose value is valid
137     */
138    public boolean isPgvValid() {
139        return pgvValid;
140    }
141    /**
142     * @return raw rule state bitmask, see {@link RuleState}
143     */
144    public int getRuleState() {
145        return ruleState;
146    }
147    public Set<RuleState> getRuleStateSet() {
148        return RuleState.fromId(ruleState);
149    }
150    /**
151     * @return raw hypo minimizer state, see {@link HoMinState}
152     */
153    public int getHoMinState() {
154        return hoMinState;
155    }
156    public HoMinState getHoMinStateEnum() {
157        return HoMinState.fromId(hoMinState);
158    }
159    /**
160     * @return raw status bitmask, see {@link Status}
161     */
162    public long getStatus() {
163        return status;
164    }
165    public Set<Status> getStatusSet() {
166        return Status.fromId(status);
167    }
168
169    public enum FmrStatus {
170        NO_FMR(0),
171        PERIODIC_GLUCOSE_READING(1),
172        CALIBRATION_RESPONSE_GLUCOSE_READING(2),
173        SENSOR_SESSION_STOPPED(3),
174        SENSOR_SESSION_STARTED(4),
175        CALIBRATION_ENTERED(5),
176        PUMPING_EVENT(6)
177
178        ;
179        private final int id;
180        FmrStatus(int id) {
181            this.id = id;
182        }
183
184        public static FmrStatus fromId(int id) {
185            for (FmrStatus r : values()) {
186                if (r.id == id) {
187                    return r;
188                }
189            }
190            return null;
191        }
192
193        public int getId() {
194            return id;
195        }
196    }
197
198    public enum RuleState {
199        HO_SUSPEND_RULE(1),
200        HO_RECOVERY_RULE(2),
201        HO_UNAVAILABLE_RULE(4)
202
203        ;
204        private final int id;
205        RuleState(int id) {
206            this.id = id;
207        }
208
209        public static Set<RuleState> fromId(int mask) {
210            Set<RuleState> items = new TreeSet<>();
211            for (RuleState i : values()) {
212                if ((mask & i.getId()) != 0) {
213                    items.add(i);
214                }
215            }
216            return items;
217        }
218
219        public int getId() {
220            return id;
221        }
222    }
223
224    public enum HoMinState {
225        ON_AND_AVAILABLE(0),
226        ON_AND_SUSPENDED(1),
227        OFF(2),
228        ON_AND_NOT_AVAILABLE(3)
229
230        ;
231        private final int id;
232        HoMinState(int id) {
233            this.id = id;
234        }
235
236        public static HoMinState fromId(int id) {
237            for (HoMinState r : values()) {
238                if (r.id == id) {
239                    return r;
240                }
241            }
242            return null;
243        }
244
245        public int getId() {
246            return id;
247        }
248    }
249
250    public enum Status {
251        SUSPEND_PREDICTED(1),
252        SUSPEND_CURRENT(2),
253        RESUME_EGV_RISE(16),
254        RESUME_NADIR_LOCK(64),
255        UNAVAILABLE_TIME_SMALL(128),
256        UNAVAILABLE_SUSPEND_OVERRIDE(256),
257        UNAVAILABLE_CGM_OFF(512),
258        UNAVAILABLE_HIGH_EGV(1024),
259        UNAVAILABLE_NOT_THERAPY(2048),
260        UNAVAILABLE_BOLUS_ACTIVE(4096),
261        UNAVAILABLE_NO_CURRENT(8192)
262
263        ;
264        private final int id;
265        Status(int id) {
266            this.id = id;
267        }
268
269        public static Set<Status> fromId(long mask) {
270            Set<Status> items = new TreeSet<>();
271            for (Status i : values()) {
272                if ((mask & i.getId()) != 0) {
273                    items.add(i);
274                }
275            }
276            return items;
277        }
278
279        public int getId() {
280            return id;
281        }
282    }
283}
